categories.name: Banking & Finance

categories.name: Travel & Accommodation
categories.definition: Planning, booking, or inquiring about travel, transportation, and lodging.

categories.name: Scheduling & Reminders
categories.definition: Setting alarms, timers, managing personal to-do lists, and scheduling events or appointments.

categories.name: Information Retrieval & General Knowledge
categories.definition: Seeking factual information, definitions, conversions, recipes, weather, general knowledge, simple calculations, or random outcomes.

categories.name: Device & Assistant Control
categories.definition: Adjusting assistant settings (voice, language, volume) or controlling general device functions (e.g., smart home, ending processes).

categories.name: Media & Entertainment
categories.definition: Controlling media playback, identifying songs, or managing playlists.

categories.name: Automotive & Vehicle Maintenance
categories.definition: Inquiries or actions related to vehicle status, maintenance, or operation.

categories.name: Personal Assistant Interaction
categories.definition: Inquiries or commands related to the assistant's identity, capabilities, or personal preferences, or setting user preferences for the assistant.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: Initiating purchases, managing shopping lists, or tracking orders for goods or services.

categories.name: Location & Navigation
categories.definition: Determining current location, sharing location, or seeking directions or nearby places.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Initiating or managing calls, texts, or other direct communication with contacts.

categories.name: General Interaction
categories.definition: Simple greetings, acknowledgements, or non-specific conversational responses that do not fit other categories.
